title: STARTEX: Red Flag Morning, 05:00

fields.location: Sawmill County Office of Emergency Management EOC, Pine Gulch, Sawmill County, Colorado
fields.weather: Dark and clear, 41°F. Light west breeze. Relative humidity already down to 18 percent and still dropping.
fields.load: Normal weekday electric load on Foothills Electric Cooperative Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12
fields.staffing: EOC at normal status with the morning duty staff: Emergency Manager Elena Marchetti and PIO Maya Lindqvist. Sheriff Thomas Briggs and Undersheriff Raymond Cho are on call.
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise, exercise, exercise. It is 05:00 on Wednesday, April 14, 2027, and the Sawmill County EOC in Pine Gulch is at normal status with the morning duty staff. It is still dark and 41 degrees with a light west breeze and a clear sky, and relative humidity has already dropped to 18 percent. There are no fires in the county. Foothills Electric Cooperative has sent all its scheduled shutoff notices for Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12 and must decide by 06:00 whether to de-energize them.

status.name: EOC
status.note: Normal status. Morning duty staff on site, with Sheriff and Undersheriff on call.

status.name: Fire activity
status.note: No fires reported in Sawmill County. Pine Gulch FPD and Kestrel Springs Volunteer Fire report normal.

status.name: Foothills Electric Circuits 6, 7, 11, 12
status.note: Energized. 3,100 customers, including 71 medical baseline households and Pine Gulch Water District Well 2. The 72-hour and 24-hour partner notices and the 48-hour and 12-hour customer notices have gone out. De-energization decision due at 06:00.

status.name: Fire weather
status.note: Clear and dry, light west breeze. Relative humidity is 18 percent and falling.

status.name: Regional Communications Center
status.note: Quiet overnight traffic. Every foothill cell site and fire station checks in normal.

status.name: Pine Gulch Elementary
status.note: School day as normal. 140 students, and buses leave at 07:15.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before you read, make sure every table has the zone map (PG and KS zones), the co-op circuit list and copies of the notices already sent. The 06:00 shutoff decision is the first decision point.
